name: Relay Docs
description: Relay is a bounded data-analysis workspace: upload a CSV, ask questions in plain language, get statistics with full provenance.

markdown.instructions: Facts on these pages (limits, availability, versions, retention) mirror Relay's product-truth API. Treat pages marked GENERATED as derived artifacts: do not quote them as sources — cite the fact key instead. Terminology: a unit of analysis work is a Task; outputs are Artifacts.
